verdict.rationale: GitLab's agent for Kubernetes documentation says you can connect a Kubernetes cluster to deploy, manage, and monitor cloud-native solutions. It also says the agent can communicate with a cluster behind a firewall or NAT, which covers every element of the story. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent working behind a firewall or NAT, and deeper documentation of the monitoring capabilities beyond a one-line claim.
